def solve():
    n, m = map(int, input().split())
    dp = [0]*(n+2)
    s = [0]*(n+2)
    dp[n] = s[n] = 1

    def add_sum(i):
        res = 0
        for j in range(2, n//i + 1):
            h = min(n+1, (i+1)*j)
            res += s[i*j] - s[h]
        return res % m

    for i in range(n-1, 0, -1):
        dp[i] = (s[i+1] + add_sum(i)) % m
        s[i] = (s[i+1] + dp[i]) % m
    print(dp[1])
solve()
